params.body:
Closes #1136

## Why

For some cars VWE sends an empty `<ConstructionDate/>`, which decodes as an empty array. `convertVweJsonToVehicle` passed it to `Carbon::createFromFormat`, which threw "Array to string conversion". The whole answer was then lost: make, version, power and cylinder capacity never reached the sheet, although VWE had sent them and the token was spent.

On production, 7 of the 187 VWE answers kept in the 30 days before 25 November failed this way.

## What changes

- **`OwnStockService::convertVweJsonToVehicle`.** It reads the construction year only when `ConstructionDate` is a `Y-m-d` date. Otherwise the year is left as it is, and the rest of the answer still counts.
- **Rules and findings.**
  - R S1-2.9 says where the year comes from and what happens without a date.
  - New finding: `een-vwe-antwoord-zonder-bouwdatum-ging-verloren`.

## Tests

- `AVweAnswerWithoutAConstructionDateStillCountsTest` (4 tests) uses the shape of the Kona's answer.
  - An empty date leaves the year out and keeps make, version, power and capacity.
  - A real date still gives the year.
  - An empty string, a `d/m/Y` date and a date with a time leave the year out.
  - A lookup that reuses the kept answer fills the sheet without an error and leaves the year it had.
- Without the fix, the lookup test fails with the field error production showed: `Array to string conversion`.
- The full suite is green (3336 tests, the same 9 notices as on main), and so are PHPStan and the rules tests.
params.title: Keep a VWE answer that has no construction date
